invariants.title: Money is integer cents; one currency.
Every change to the quantity on hand is a stock move, written by core's stock door; the moves add up to on hand.
Cost is derived (moving average), never typed, except the opening cost of stock that came in without one.
Each unit leaves at the average of that moment; cost of goods sold is that cost, per shipment line.
Stock without a cost is named with its quantity, never valued at zero in silence.
A count records what was counted, with a reason; the difference is valued at the average.
Valuation as of a date equals the journal's Inventory balance for that date.
The journal derives balanced: shipments to cost of goods sold, counts to adjustments, opening stock to equity.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
